response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a thesis project, with the last decade dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL practice, MQTT, industrial protocols, or automation-domain experience, all of which are central to this position.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering with strong seniority and mentoring/teaching track record
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby
Event-driven architecture and distributed-systems exposure via GISCollective and microservices work
concerns: Minimal recent C++/STL experience; core language for the role is essentially stale since ~2015
No industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 background whatsoever
No IoT/industrial automation domain exposure (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, etc.); Azure absent (AWS only)
